title: UI风格#63 - Art Deco Glamour (装饰艺术魅力)
description: 创建第63种UI风格：装饰艺术魅力风格 - 爵士时代、金色几何、帝国大厦。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Glamour style When color palette Then features gold, black, cream, emerald, sapphire
Given Art Deco Glamour style When typography Then uses deco fonts: Poiret One, Josefin Sans, or Art Deco
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Poiret One (headers 3.5rem), Josefin Sans (body 0.95rem 300 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Glamour style When layout Then sunburst patterns, chevron lines, symmetric geometry
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: conic sunburst gradient background, geometric diamond border top, chevron divider (5 V shapes), symmetric layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Glamour style When UI elements Then gilded borders, sunburst motifs, geometric frames
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gold borders and icons, inner frame on chat, gold text shadows, uppercase tracking on labels, gradient gold button

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Glamour UI When functional Then includes ballroom chat, debutante agents, glamour stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: ballroom chat, 4 debutante agents (Jordan/Daisy/Nick/Fitzgerald) with Charm/Glamour/Pearls/Sparkle/Sprints/Class/Tests/Quality stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Glamour UI When copy Then uses jazz age: 'Gatsby', 'Ballroom', 'Glamour', 'Empire'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'GATSBY. BALLROOM. EMPIRE.', tagline 'The charm of a golden age', button 'DANCE', greeting 'Welcome to the grand ballroom', status 'Dancing'/'Idle', nav 'Manhattan'/'Atelier'/'Empire' with ◆ symbols
